result.title: Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
result.summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Refin3R，用 SfM 稀疏点云精化前馈式点图：2D 分支借助几何感知骨干特征把 SfM 几何扩展到其覆盖范围之外，3D 分支在所有视图的点集上建模多视图结构，两支路双向交互以输出稠密准确点图。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稀疏几何证据在稠密网格上传播 + 跨视图双向状态交换」的结构，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据注入与 latent 状态更新的设计提供核查线索，但论文本身不涉及推理或答案生成。
